scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:app && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:extension && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.clean:packages: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs packages/argus-core packages/argus-client packages/argus-plugin-api packages/argus-plugin-google-sheets packages/argus-watcher packages/argus
scripts.build:packages: npm run clean:packages && tsc -b tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @vforsh/argus bundle
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:packages && npm run build:extension && npm run test:unit && bun scripts/test-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:extension: bun run build:packages && npm run build:extension && bun test e2e/extension-live.test.ts
scripts.test:playground: bun run build:packages && bun test e2e/playground-*.test.ts
